messages:
Maria (finance): Heads up — saw weird invoice lines for March in asia-south1. Several network egress entries are being charged on accelerator (GPU) lines, looks like duplicate billing for ~USD 18,400. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Alex (infra): Can you paste the invoice id / sample lines? Will check mapping to our cost center tags.
Maria (finance): Attached sample from the exported CSV: 
```
invoice_id,sku_description,region,usage_amount,cost
INV-2027-03-asiaS,Accelerator usage (nvidia-t4),asia-south1,1200,15200.00
INV-2027-03-asiaS,Network Egress (10GB),asia-south1,10,1800.00
INV-2027-03-asiaS,Accelerator network egress,asia-south1,10,18422.07
```
Alex (infra): Hmm, that third line looks like a combined/duplicated item. Will grep our billing export config to see how that mapping could have happened.
Kai (cloudops): FYI provider pushed a pricing/tax reclassification last week in asia-south1 — they apparently moved some egress charges into accelerator-related SKUs for attachments to GPU instances. I filed a ticket but didn't realise invoices already picked it up. Ticket CLOUD-98765.
Chris (eng-sre): Ran a quick scan of our node labels. Found an old provisioning script that adds `accelerator_network=true` for gpu pools in asia-south1. That label is used in our billing export tag mapping. Only affects autoscaled pool `pool-rl-autoscale`.
Maria (finance): OK can you paste the count and rough cost exposure you see? We need numbers for FIN reconciliation.
Chris (eng-sre): Count: 12 nodes matching label in asia-south1. Rough attributed cost on invoice snippet ~18.4k (looks like invoice combined accelerator + egress).
Alex (infra): I'll patch the autoscaler script to stop setting that label and open a backfill job to rewrite the billing export tags for Jan-Mar. Opening infra ticket INFRA-764.
Kai (cloudops): Provider support acknowledged a backend reclassification bug on their side and created an internal escalation. They asked for the CSV lines and line IDs — Maria, can you DM the full CSV to the support case? They gave an initial credit ETA but want full sample lines.
billing-bot: Created internal ticket FIN-BILL-211 to track credits and reconciliation. Estimated 3-5 business days for credit posting.
Chris (eng-sre): Command I used to validate nodes:
```
# list nodes with bad label
kubectl get nodes --selector=accelerator_network=true -o wide
```
We have 12 in `pool-rl-autoscale` (asia-south1).
Maria (finance): Please add the invoice line IDs and the full cost numbers to FIN-BILL-211 once you have them. CFO asked whether this affects our reserved capacity commitments.
Kai (cloudops): Provider says credits will be applied at line-item level and will not retroactively change committed usage counts, so Dedicated/reserved commitments should be unaffected. But they recommended we reconcile committed vs billed usage for Jan-Mar anyway.
Alex (infra): Action items: patch provisioning script (PR #452), run backfill for Jan-Mar tags (infra/backfill-billing.sh), coordinate with finance once credits land.
Maria (finance): Also flagging a small tax delta — provider sometimes reassigns VAT when reclassifying SKUs. Please watch for any taxline changes in the credits.
Kai (cloudops): Will monitor tax reclassification and follow up in provider case.
billing-bot: Updated FIN-BILL-211 with provider case CLOUD-98765 and support ETA.
Maria (finance): Owners assigned: Alex (label fix + backfill), Kai (provider escalation + tax), Chris (node inventory), Maria (reconciliation + CFO updates). Reconvene in 48h for status. :white_check_mark:
